Then again, I do have the yellow monopoly with Atlantic, Ventnor, and Marvin Gardens, though no houses built yet since I lack cash to build. Trading isn't promising either since the other player only has $26 and a couple weak properties, so I'll just end my turn and mortgage something only if I'm actually forced to pay.
